description: 14 CFR 91.157's special VFR for an airplane (eCFR, current on 2026-11-21): within the surface area of an airport's Class B, C, D or E airspace and below 10,000 ft MSL (91.157(a)), never at the airports of part 91 appendix D, section 3 (fixed-wing special VFR prohibited: O'Hare, LaGuardia and 31 more, by FAA or ICAO ident); with an ATC clearance, clear of clouds and at least 1 statute mile flight visibility (91.157(b)(1)-(3)); between sunset and sunrise (in Alaska, the sun more than 6 degrees below the horizon) only for a pilot meeting part 61's requirements for instrument flight in an airplane equipped as 91.205(d) asks (91.157(b)(4)); and to take off or land, at least 1 sm ground visibility, or flight visibility where none is reported (91.157(c)). `available` is false where anything known rules it out (each in `problems`); what is not given rules nothing out and stays in `needs`, never said to be met.

surface_area.description: The class of the surface area the airplane is in (controlled airspace designated to the surface for an airport); null or G where it is in none.

airport.description: The surface area's primary airport, FAA or ICAO ident, for appendix D, section 3.

altitude_ft.description: Feet MSL; null where not known.

night.description: Between sunset and sunrise; null where not known.

alaska.description: In Alaska, where 91.157(b)(4) reads the sun's elevation.

sun_elevation_deg.description: The sun's elevation, degrees (negative below the horizon); read in Alaska alone.

instrument_current.description: The pilot meets part 61's requirements for instrument flight (rated, and current under 61.57(c)).

ifr_equipped.description: The airplane is equipped as 91.205(d) asks for IFR.

ground_visibility_sm.description: Statute miles, as reported at the airport; null where none is.

clear_of_clouds.description: Whether the flight can keep clear of clouds.

takeoff_or_landing.description: Taking off or landing under special VFR (91.157(c)).

available.description: Nothing known rules special VFR out.

problems.description: What rules it out, each with its rule.

needs.description: What it asks, each with its rule.

listed.description: The airport's entry in part 91 appendix D, section 3, "Chicago, IL (Chicago-O'Hare International Airport)"; null where it is not listed.
